content: Event-driven multi-agent systems typically use an event bus (Kafka/SNS-SQS class, or simpler in-process/Postgres LISTEN-NOTIFY at small scale) with CQRS: commands trigger actions, events record facts that already happened. Two coordination styles: choreography (agents react independently to events, simpler at small scale) vs orchestration (a coordinator issues commands and reacts to results, easier to reason about as workflow complexity grows). Event sourcing keeps an append-only immutable event log; current state is a projection/read-model built by replaying or folding events, enabling audit history and replay.
